name: Cell detachment and QC module v1
description: A deliberately SMALL 90 x 50 mm module: it detaches adherent cells enzymatically, neutralises on the way out, and gives a counting window. It does NOT wash, filter, concentrate or exchange buffer, and that is a decision rather than an omission. Those four steps were costed against a bench tube and lost: at a 100 um feature floor, deterministic lateral displacement needs 12-45 um gaps, impedance counting needs a 20-50 um aperture, a pillar gap that removes 30-40 um clumps is impossible, and the final viscous resuspension (about 75 cP) collapses the Reynolds number by ~75x so inertial focusing stops working altogether. Doing all six steps on chip gives roughly 0.35 cumulative recovery in about 50 min; the two kept here plus a tube give roughly 0.7 in about 30 min. cult_1 is the adherent chamber and the only heated zone; mix_1 is a serpentine that neutralises by co-flowing quench buffer, because diffusion alone across 100 um would take ~100 s; qc_1 is a plain transparent window, 150 um deep, imaged from outside by a phone or USB microscope. Every feature is >= 100 um, one embossing depth, no photolithography. Geometry is ours; the methods it serves are cited in protocols/cell_prep_v1.json.

chambers.note: Adherent growth area, 3 cm2, which holds roughly 300k cells at typical density. That is already far more than this pipeline needs: 50,000 capsules at a mean of 0.2 cells each consume only about 10,000 cells. The only heated zone on the board.

Serpentine neutralisation. Quench co-flows here rather than being added to the chamber, so the enzyme stops the moment cells leave rather than minutes later. Mixing has to be advective: diffusion across a 100 um channel takes about 100 s.

Static counting window, 150 um deep, which is about a haemocytometer's depth. Stopped-flow, imaged from outside. Counting ~400 cells gives a 5% Poisson CV, and a 20% concentration error only moves single-capsule occupancy by about 15%, so this is accurate enough and an in-line counter is not worth building.

ports.note: To a chilled tube. Everything after this is bench: spin, 40 um strainer, resuspend.
